meta.name: prisma-mongodb-upgrade
meta.description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma 8. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma 8 mongodb".

copy.tagline: 评估 MongoDB 项目能否升级 ORM 版本,并给出迁移路线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 MongoDB 项目想升 Prisma,却不确定能不能升、怎么升
copy.tagline_en: Decide whether your MongoDB app can upgrade its ORM, then plan the move
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your MongoDB project needs a Prisma upgrade and the path is unclear

howto.what: 当你在 MongoDB 项目里问要不要升级 Prisma,Claude 会说明 v6 是 MongoDB 的最后一个大版本、v7 没有 MongoDB 连接器,并帮你判断是迁到 Prisma 8(早期访问)还是留在 v6,再给出对应迁移要点。
howto.when: 当 MongoDB 项目(provider = "mongodb")问起升级 Prisma、出现「upgrade to Prisma 7」的说法,或在评估迁到 Prisma 8 时接管。

say.text: 我们的 MongoDB 项目要不要升级到 Prisma 7?
say.note: 会被告知 v7 没有 MongoDB 连接器,这条路不存在。

say.text: 这个 MongoDB 项目该留在 v6 还是迁到 Prisma 8?
say.note: 会按决策表判断,并检查 $transaction 等阻断项。

say.text: 帮我把 v6 的 schema 迁到 Prisma 8 的写法。
say.note: 给出 schema 契约映射,并提示先在副本上演练。

howto.what_en: Ask about upgrading Prisma in a MongoDB project and Claude explains v6 is the last MongoDB major — v7 has no MongoDB connector — then helps decide between migrating to Prisma 8 or staying on v6, with migration steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a MongoDB project (provider = "mongodb") asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to Prisma 7" comes up, or when evaluating a move to Prisma 8.

say_en.text: Should our MongoDB project upgrade to Prisma 7?
say_en.note: You'll hear v7 has no MongoDB connector — that path doesn't exist.

say_en.text: Should this MongoDB project stay on v6 or move to Prisma 8?
say_en.note: Claude applies the decision table and checks blockers like $transaction.

say_en.text: Help me port my v6 schema to Prisma 8.
say_en.note: Gives schema contract mapping and says to rehearse on a copy.
